+from click.testing import _NamedTextIOWrapper

+def test_named_text_wrapper_does_not_close_shared_buffer():
+    buffer = BytesIO()
+    first = _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "first", "w", encoding="utf-8")
+    second = _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "second", "w", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    first.close()
+    second.write("still open")
+    second.close()
+
+    assert buffer.getvalue() == b"still open"
+
+
+def test_isolation_streams_remain_readable_after_finalization():
+    runner = CliRunner()
+
+    with runner.isolation() as (stdout, stderr, output):
+        sys.stdout.write("stdout")
+        sys.stderr.write("stderr")
+
+    gc.collect()
+
+    assert stdout.getvalue() == b"stdout"
+    assert stderr.getvalue() == b"stderr"
+    assert output.getvalue() == b"stdoutstderr"
